title: fix(spec): JobSchema's own @example no longer opens with the retired `id` key
body:
Fixes #19184

Clause-②: no

`JobSchema`'s TSDoc `@example` opened with `id`, the key removed in 17.0.0 (#4667, ADR-0049) and tombstoned a dozen lines below the block that wrote it. The repository's own example was therefore refused by the schema it documents on a verbatim copy. One line is deleted; the schema, the tombstone and its prescription are untouched.

## The two readings the card marked NOT measured by the filer

Both were attributed rather than adopted on the card, and both were re-run here, first-hand, on this branch.

**1. Parse side — confirmed.** The example was extracted from the source by anchor (not retyped) and parsed:

```
JobSchema.safeParse(the block as written)
  success: false
  code: unrecognized_keys · keys: ["id"]
  message: Unrecognized key(s) on this job: `id`.
           • `job.id` was removed in @objectstack/spec 17.0.0 (ADR-0049) — nothing ever read it …
             `name` IS the job's identity everywhere … Delete the key; rename the job via `name` …
```

Control leg, same probe, same run: the identical object with `id` deleted answers `success: true`. So `id` was the only defect in that block — the cron expression string, `timezone: "UTC"`, the handler string and both `retryPolicy` keys all parse — and deleting the line is the entire fix.

**2. Blast radius — confirmed, three ways.** The block is source TSDoc and reaches no generated page:

- `content/docs/references/system/job.mdx` carries the `.describe()` text of this very file verbatim (positive control: the `timezone` description, matched byte for byte) and carries no part of the `@example`. Grep for `Metadata Sync Job (Cron)` and `sync_metadata_nightly` over `content/docs/`: zero hits, against a firing control (`timeoutMs` matches five reference pages).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` reports all 16 generated artifacts up to date after the edit — `check:docs` among them — so the change moves no generated byte.
- It does not reach `dist` either: the distinctive phrase of the block has zero hits under `packages/spec/dist/` after a full build, while the sibling `defineJob` example (a fenced `ts` block) is present in the emitted `.d.ts`. The block travels to consumers through the tarball's **source** file, not the declarations.

## Why one block and not a family — re-derived here

The file's second `@example`, on `defineJob`, was extracted and tested by the same probe: it carries no `id`, no `timeout` and no `retryDelayMs`. It is untouched, as is `JOB_ID_RETIRED` and every other retirement mechanism. The package-wide `@example` question is a separate card and is deliberately not started here.

Worth recording, because it is why this survived: `check:skill-examples` type-checks prose examples across three surfaces, including spec source TSDoc — but its population is **fenced** code blocks (ts / tsx / typescript), 10 of them in spec sources. This `@example` is a bare object literal with no fence, so no instrument in the repo reads it. The fix is the example; the gap is noted, not widened.

## The pin

`JobSchema's own @example (#19184)` in `packages/spec/src/system/job.test.ts` reads the block **out of the source** rather than restating it — a restated copy is a second declaration and rots green. It carries an extraction assertion (an unmatched anchor fails loudly instead of parsing an empty string) and a firing control: re-adding `id` must still be refused with `unrecognized_keys` naming `id` and a message carrying the version and the replacement identity. Without that leg a pin that accepts anything would read as green.

## Changeset — measured, not assumed

`patch` on `@objectstack/spec`, and `skip-changeset` was measured wrong rather than skipped by convention:

- `packages/spec` is public at 17.4.0 and its `files` list includes `src/**/*.zod.ts`.
- `npm pack --dry-run --json` lists `src/system/job.zod.ts` among the 2042 files of the tarball. The corrected block is shipped content, so the diff publishes.
- `Clause-②: no` is a measurement too: a full `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` leaves every tracked generated artifact byte-identical (`git status` clean), and `check:authorable-surface` is green — the accept set does not move, because only a comment changed.

## Verification

Run on `cf3e8107b1`, the final commit of this branch.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local src/system/job.test.ts` — 59 passed (55 before, 4 new).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` — exit 0; `check:test-typecheck` OK with the debt ledger unmoved (54 files / 259 errors / 144 pinned signatures, shrink-only).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` — 16 of 16 artifacts up to date.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` — 258 prose examples type-check across 3 surfaces (first run refused for an unbuilt `client-react/dist`; re-run after building that package, which is what the refusal asked for).
- Green, each exit code captured before any pipe: `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`, `check:comment-mask-adoption`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`, `check:keyed-text-bounds`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check:published-files`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:objectui-changeset`, `check:pm-changeset-deadline-census`, and the spec source audits `check:duration-unit-keys`, `check:yaml-examples`, `check:empty-state`, `check:exported-any`, `check:variant-docs`, `check:dual-source-exports`, `check:entry-nameability`, `check:browser-reachable-entries`, `check:llms-txt`, `check:objectui-pin-citations`.
- eslint over the two touched TypeScript files: 2 files judged, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The narrowing is declared: this config runs no type-aware rules (no `parserOptions.project`, stated in the config itself), so this diff cannot move the verdict on a file it does not touch; the repo-wide sweep stays CI's.

Declared narrowings, so the reviewer reads coverage rather than infers it: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciles 28 of 81 derived families as run here; the remaining 53 are repo-wide ratchets and whole-tree sweeps that CI owns. The clause-② level axis of `check-changeset-no-major` reports NOT APPLICABLE locally — it reads a `pull_request` payload, so this PR's own run is its first real reading. The branch is two commits behind `main` at the time of writing, and `dispatch-gates` flags its own derivation stale for `ci.yml` on that account.

## Acceptance notes

Noted while measuring, not fixed here, not filed by this PR:

- The same example's `handler: "services/syncStatus.ts:syncAll"` parses (the key is a plain string) but names something the runtime cannot resolve: `AppPlugin` resolves a job handler as a straight key lookup into `bundle.functions`, and a miss logs `job handler not found in bundle.functions — skipping` at `warn` and schedules nothing. The working spelling is a bare function key — `handler: 'sweepProjectHealth'` in `examples/app-showcase`, and the sibling `defineJob` example in this very file. Same block, different failure mode from the card's (accepted at parse, inert at boot), so it is reported rather than ridden in on this PR.
- The `handler` line also carries a trailing space. Style only; left alone.
